dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いします。1600ちょうどに始めさせて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for joining today. We'll start right at 4:00 PM.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I'm looking forward to our session.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。初めに、あなたの年齢、性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。35才、女性です
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm 35 years old, female.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 夫の子どもへの関わり方に対する私の悩みなのですが、よろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I'm concerned about how my husband interacts with our children. Is that okay to talk about?

dialogue.content: はい、もちろんです。どんなことからでもいいのでもう少し詳しくお話しを聞いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, of course. Could you please tell me a bit more about it, starting from wherever you'd like?

dialogue.content: ２人の娘がいますが、夫は次女ばかりえこひいきをするのです
dialogue.English: We have two daughters, but my husband plays favorites with the younger one.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それは嫌な思いをされますね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be upsetting for you.

dialogue.content: えこひいきと感じるのはどのようなことからでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In what ways do you feel he's playing favorites?

dialogue.content: 親として公平でいて欲しいです
dialogue.English: As a parent, I want him to be fair to both of them.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思われるのですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can understand why you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: 姉妹の喧嘩に、あたかも自分は次女になってしまったかのように、一緒に長女に攻撃したりします
dialogue.English: When the sisters fight, it's as if he becomes the younger daughter himself and gangs up on the older one.

dialogue.content: 私が次女をしつけで叱るときも、私を攻撃します
dialogue.English: Even when I’m disciplining our younger daughter, he turns on me.

dialogue.content: えぇ、えぇ。例えばどのような喧嘩のときにそのようになるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. For example, what kind of fights trigger this behavior?

dialogue.content: ささいな子どもの物の取り合いなど、順番こにしようねというのが大人の対応かと思いますが
dialogue.English: It's usually over trivial things, like fighting over a toy. I think the adult response would be to tell them to take turns, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I see.

dialogue.content: 次女を抱いて、長女にキックさせたり
dialogue.English: He’ll hold the younger one and have her kick the older one.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…それは困ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very difficult to deal with.

dialogue.content: 冗談にもほどがあります
dialogue.English: It's beyond a joke.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思われるのも自然ですよね…
dialogue.English: Yes, it's only natural that you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: 娘さんお二人はそれぞれ何歳なのですか？
dialogue.English: How old are your two daughters?

dialogue.content: 8才と5才です。
dialogue.English: Eight and five.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか旦那様のそのような行動はいつ頃から続いてるのでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see. How long has your husband been acting this way?

dialogue.content: 次女が可愛いらしく、夫の暗証番号も次女の誕生日なんです
dialogue.English: He just adores the younger one. His PIN is even her birthday.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。それほど旦那様は可愛がってるのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So he really dotes on her that much.

dialogue.content: 長女は単身赴任の時期も重なり、また主人の父親としての自覚も芽生えなかったのか、あまりなつかなかったのですよね
dialogue.English: When our older daughter was a baby, he was away on a long-term business assignment. Maybe because of that, and because his sense of being a father hadn't kicked in, she never really warmed up to him.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そのようなことがあったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's what was happening at the time.

dialogue.content: 単身赴任されてたのはいつ頃からいつまでされてたのですか？
dialogue.English: When was his work assignment away from home, from when to when?

dialogue.content: 長女がゼロ才から一才半くらい
dialogue.English: From when our older daughter was a newborn until she was about one and a half.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。単身赴任が終わってからは旦那様はどのような様子でしたか？
dialogue.English: I understand. And what was your husband like after the assignment ended and he came back?

dialogue.content: 長女が懐かないのでなおさら、育児にあまり関わらず、気の向いた時だけという感じでした
dialogue.English: Since our older daughter wouldn't warm up to him, he was even less involved in parenting. He would only help out when he felt like it.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。育児の面でも大変な思いをされてきたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you've had a very difficult time with childcare as well.

dialogue.content: 育児に関してその際旦那様とお話ししたことはあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever tried talking to your husband about parenting?

dialogue.content: こちらから何かいうと文句ととらえるので、話し合いは難しいです
dialogue.English: If I try to say anything, he takes it as a complaint, so it's difficult to have a discussion.

dialogue.content: 次女のことも言うと、図星なのか？言われたくないと怒ります
dialogue.English: When I mention the favoritism toward the younger one, maybe because it hits a nerve, he gets angry and says he doesn’t want to hear it.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…文句と捉えられると悲しい気持ちになってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be sad to have him interpret your concerns as complaints.

dialogue.content: 次女さんのどんなことを旦那様に伝えるのですか？
dialogue.English: What sort of things do you try to tell your husband regarding your younger daughter?

dialogue.content: 次女だけかばうと次女がわがままになるから、きちんとダメなことはダメと我慢を教えたいなど
dialogue.English: Things like, if he only defends her, she'll become selfish, so I want to teach her that some things are not okay and she needs to learn patience.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: そのように伝えると旦那様はどんなことを？
dialogue.English: And how does your husband react when you tell him that?

dialogue.content: はぁ？って怒ってみたり、どこかへ行ってしまったり、向き合ってくれません
dialogue.English: He gets angry and goes, 'What?!' or just walks away. He won't face the issue.

dialogue.content: 自分が次男でつらい思いをしたのを転移しているような気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like he's projecting his own painful experiences as the second son.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。せっかく勇気を出して話したのに向き合ってくれないとなると辛いですよね…
dialogue.English: I see. It must be very painful when you gather the courage to talk, only for him to refuse to engage.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そのように思われるのですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I can see why you would think that.

dialogue.content: 旦那様は次男としてどのような辛い思いをされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of painful experiences did your husband have as the second son?

dialogue.content: 兄は親の仕事の後継者として大切に育てられていたようです。優秀で優しくて。
dialogue.English: It seems his older brother was raised to be the successor to the family business and was cherished. He was smart and kind.

dialogue.content: 夫はいつも頑固で育てにくかったと義母は言います。
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law says my husband was always stubborn and difficult to raise.

dialogue.content: 兄へのコンプレックスがあるように思います
dialogue.English: I think he has a complex about his brother.

dialogue.content: えぇ、ええ。そうだったのですね。なるほど…
dialogue.English: I see. So that's the background. That makes sense...

dialogue.content: それを次女様に自分を反映させてるのではないかとお考えなのですね？
dialogue.English: So you think he may be projecting himself onto your younger daughter?

dialogue.content: ちなみに、旦那様は長女さんが産まれるとなった際に子供ができることに関してどのように言ってましたか？
dialogue.English: Out of curiosity, when you were expecting your older daughter, how did your husband feel about having a child?

dialogue.content: はい、私からみたら両方悪いと思うケンカをむきになって大人の夫が長女にずるいと言ったりするので。
dialogue.English: Yes. When they get into a fight where I think they're both at fault, my husband—a grown man—gets worked up and tells our older daughter that she's being unfair.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 子どもができることは嬉しそうでした。育児には興味なさそうで、私に任せっきりではありますが。
dialogue.English: He seemed happy about having a child. But he didn't seem interested in raising them and left it all to me.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。これまでのお話を少しまとめさせていただくと、
dialogue.English: I see. Let me try to summarize what you've told me so far.

dialogue.content: 旦那様が次女を可愛がっており、えこひいきに感じる。その原因は自分が次男であったことと、兄にコンプレックスを抱いてたことからの原因ではないかと思っているまた、単身赴任で長女は旦那様にあまり懐かなかったのと、旦那様の父親としての自覚がまだ湧かなかったのが原因なのではないかと思っている
dialogue.English: You feel your husband dotes on your younger daughter and plays favorites. You suspect the reason might be his own experiences as a second son and the complex he has about his older brother. You also think it could be because your older daughter didn't warm up to him due to his long business assignment, and because his own sense of being a father hadn't developed yet.

dialogue.content: はい、その通りです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: 育児には非協力的で、話をしようとしても向き合ってくれないということでした
dialogue.English: And he's uncooperative with parenting and won't engage in a discussion when you try to talk about it.

dialogue.content: ええ、あなた様がいちばん悩んでいること、ここで1番解決したいことはどんなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Okay. What is the biggest concern you have, the main thing you'd like to resolve here?

dialogue.content: 私がのぞむのは、この状態でも、2人がもともに育ってくれることです
dialogue.English: What I want is for both of them to grow up to be well-adjusted, even in this situation.

dialogue.content: このままでは、長女も父親を嫌いになるでしょう
dialogue.English: At this rate, our older daughter will come to dislike her father.

dialogue.content: 次女はわがままになるでしょう
dialogue.English: And the younger one will become spoiled.

dialogue.content: ↑もとも→まとも
dialogue.English: (Correction: I meant for them to grow up well-adjusted.)

dialogue.content: そのように思われてるのですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how you’re feeling about it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これについては、旦那様ともお話を重ねて行きたいところはあるのですが、あなた自身が今できることを一緒に考えていければと思います。
dialogue.English: This is something that you would ideally discuss further with your husband, but for now, I'd like for us to think together about what you can do yourself.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: 普段、旦那様の長女に対する言動や行動はどんなかんじなのですか？
dialogue.English: Usually, what are your husband's words and actions like toward your older daughter?

dialogue.content: 仕事や出張で家にいる時間は少ないので、彼が不在の時間はかえって平和です
dialogue.English: He's not home much because of work and business trips, so it's actually more peaceful when he's away.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そうなのですね(聞いています)
dialogue.English: I see. (I'm listening.)

dialogue.content: 普段もあまり関心ないようで。
dialogue.English: Even when he's here, he doesn't seem very interested in her.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ただ、姉妹のケンカや私が叱ったりしていると
dialogue.English: But when the sisters are fighting or I'm scolding them...

dialogue.content: 変に関わってきて面倒なのです
dialogue.English: ...he gets involved in a strange way, and it's a hassle.

dialogue.content: なるほど…それは大変ですよね反対に、次女さんに対する育児の状況や言動はどうでしょう？
dialogue.English: I understand... that must be very trying. On the other hand, how does he act and what does he say when it comes to parenting your younger daughter?

dialogue.content: 自分が可愛がるペットみたいにしています
dialogue.English: He treats her like a pet that he adores.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなのですね。それは子育てに対して不安を覚えますよね…
dialogue.English: I see. That would certainly make you feel anxious about her upbringing.

dialogue.content: そんな状況で、長女さんは旦那様をどのように見ていますか？
dialogue.English: In this situation, how does your older daughter seem to view her father?

dialogue.content: 懐かせたいのでしょうかね、あまりに短絡的
dialogue.English: Maybe he wants her to like him, but his methods are just so shortsighted.

dialogue.content: あまり好きではないと思います。ママ大好きな子なので。
dialogue.English: I don't think she likes him very much. She's a real mama's girl.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは家族として寂しいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must feel lonely for you as a family.

dialogue.content: 長女さんと次女さんはどんなやりとりをされてますか？
dialogue.English: How do your older and younger daughters interact with each other?

dialogue.content: 娘2人と大きな息子がいる感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like I have two daughters and one big son.

dialogue.content: 2人はとても仲良しです長女はとても優しく、わがままな次女にがまん強くしています
dialogue.English: The two of them get along very well. The older one is very kind and is patient with her willful younger sister.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そうだったのですね？そのように思われるのも自然ですよね…
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is. It's natural you'd feel that way.

dialogue.content: 次女さんがわがままになってしまうのではないか…と心配されてましたが、実際にそのようになってしまったと感じたことはありましたか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're worried your younger daughter might become selfish. Have you seen any signs of that actually happening?

dialogue.content: 夫のいない日、時間の方が多いので、普段は2人を公平に育児をこころがけています。彼のいるときだけ、かえって乱されます。夫が次女を不自然にかばうので、母親の躾を聞かなくなりそうです
dialogue.English: He's away more often than he's home, so I usually try to raise them both fairly. It's only when he's here that things get disrupted. Because my husband defends her unnaturally, I'm afraid she's starting to not listen to my discipline.

dialogue.content: ええ、旦那様がいない日はどのくらいあるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. About how often is your husband away?

dialogue.content: 我慢しないで、夫にいいつけにいきますから。
dialogue.English: She doesn't hold back; she goes and tells on me to her father.

dialogue.content: 平日はいません　夜遅く帰宅です
dialogue.English: He's not here on weekdays. He comes home late at night.

dialogue.content: 週末もいたりいなかったりです
dialogue.English: And on weekends, sometimes he's here, sometimes he's not.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そうなのですね？我慢しないで言いつけるというのはどのようなことを言うのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. When you say she tells on you without holding back, what kind of things does she say?

dialogue.content: ママにこう言われたと夫に言い、夫はママはうるさいねと言う具合です。
dialogue.English: She'll tell him, "Mom said this," and he'll say something like, "Mom is so nagging."

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。それは困ってしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: それ以外に今の時点で次女さんの気になる部分はどんなことがありそうですか？
dialogue.English: Besides that, are there any other concerning behaviors from your younger daughter at this point?

dialogue.content: 躾方針を夫婦で共有できない、一貫性を持たせられないのです。いっそのこと、関わらずに任せていてくれた方がまだいいと思うこともあります
dialogue.English: We can't share a consistent discipline approach as a couple. Sometimes I think it would be better if he just stayed out of it and left it all to me.

dialogue.content: 甘やかしてくれる存在がいるからか、いつまでもわがままをいって、だだをこねますね
dialogue.English: Perhaps because there’s someone who spoils her, she keeps making selfish demands and throwing tantrums.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。たまにしか帰ってこない環境もあり、難しいように思います
dialogue.English: Yes. Given that he's only home occasionally, I can imagine that makes things difficult.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。そうだったのですね。次女さんは5歳とおっしゃってましたが、幼稚園や保育園ではどのようなご様子ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned your younger daughter is five. What is she like at kindergarten or preschool?

dialogue.content: 外ではいい子にしています
dialogue.English: She's a good girl when she's out.

dialogue.content: 家の中でわがままを出す感じです
dialogue.English: It's at home that she acts selfish.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。お父さんには甘えたいのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. She wants to be pampered by her father.

dialogue.content: 厳しい存在と甘える存在、両方あってもいいと思うときもありますけどね。。
dialogue.English: Sometimes I think it’s fine to have both a strict figure and a person she can lean on, though...

dialogue.content: そのようにおもわれるのですね。大事なことですね。5歳というと自我が芽生えはじめてくる年頃でもあると思います。外ではしっかりしなくてはという理性と、家では無意識に甘えたいという行動が出てるのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: I can see why you'd think that. It's an important point. Five is an age when their sense of self really starts to develop. It could be that she has the rational thought to behave outside, while at home the unconscious desire to be pampered comes out.

dialogue.content: ここまでお話をお伺いして、できることを考えてみたのですが…
dialogue.English: Based on what you've shared so far, I've thought about some possible steps...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: このお話については旦那様の協力が必要だと思いました。ですが向き合ってくれない、ということでしたね。ですがお話を聞いていて、旦那様は長女さんを嫌いなわけではないと思うのです。無意識に幼い頃の自分を反映してそのような行動をとっている。旦那様に長女さんのことをどう思うのか聞いてみるっていうのも一つですよね。
dialogue.English: I think your husband's cooperation will be necessary for this issue. You’ve said he won’t engage, but from what I’ve heard, I don’t think he dislikes your older daughter. He may be unconsciously acting out parts of his own childhood. One option is to ask him directly how he feels about your older daughter.

dialogue.content: あとはあなた自身が旦那様のいない時にお二人のことを差別なく接してるということ、家族のことを大事に思うからこそそのような悩みが出てくるのだと思います
dialogue.English: Also, I believe these concerns arise precisely because you care so deeply about your family and treat both children without favoritism when your husband isn't around.

dialogue.content: そうですね、それは聞いてみたいし、気づかせたいです。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'd like to ask him that, and I want him to realize it.

dialogue.content: はい、私はなんとか夫に巻き込まれず、家族のバランスをとりたいと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to somehow avoid getting dragged into my husband's issues and maintain a balance in the family.

dialogue.content: ぜひ旦那様がいても、お二人の子に愛情を精一杯注いでください。子供は親からどのくらい愛情を注がれているかをしっかり見るものです。
dialogue.English: Please, even when your husband is there, continue to pour all your love into both your children. Children are very perceptive about how much love they're receiving from their parents.

dialogue.content: おっしゃる通りですね。
dialogue.English: You’re absolutely right.

dialogue.content: ええ、本当にあなたの愛情溢れる心には感銘を受けました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m truly impressed by how full of love your heart is.

dialogue.content: そして
dialogue.English: And...

dialogue.content: 子供がまともに育って欲しいということを特に心配されてましたね。親として当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: You were especially worried about your children growing up to be well-adjusted. I think that's a natural concern for any parent.

dialogue.content: はい、長女にも夫からの愛情も歪んで伝わらないように、説明してあげたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to explain things to my older daughter so that her father’s love doesn’t come across in a distorted way.

dialogue.content: 長女さんに関してはとても優しい心を持っていて面倒見がよいと言ってました。次女さんに関しては家では甘えん坊だけど外ではいい子でしたね。ぜひそのような素敵な点も褒めてあげてくださいね。
dialogue.English: You mentioned your older daughter has a very kind heart and is a good caretaker. And your younger daughter is affectionate at home but well-behaved outside. Please be sure to praise them for those wonderful qualities.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思われるのですね？とても大切な点ですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s how you feel—and that’s a very important point.

dialogue.content: はい、そうしたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll do that.

dialogue.content: わがままになるのではないか…旦那様を嫌いになるのではないか…さまざまな不安はつきものです。ですが、実際にいまそうではないなら先を不必要に不安がる必要はないと私は思います。また実際にそうなってから考えると自ずと答えは出てくるものです。
dialogue.English: Will she become selfish? Will she come to hate her father? All kinds of worries are bound to come up. But if that's not the reality right now, I don't think you need to be unnecessarily anxious about the future. If that time comes, I believe the answer will naturally present itself.

dialogue.content: あなたならできると思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I believe you can do it.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。1日1日、精一杯できることをしていけばいいですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I’ll just do what I can each day, one day at a time.

dialogue.content: お話して、整理できました
dialogue.English: Talking with you has helped me sort out my thoughts.

dialogue.content: はい、素敵な点に気づくことができましたね。とても頑張り屋さんなあなたなので、ぜひ自分に優しい時間も作ってください。できることから一つずつ…です。
dialogue.English: Yes, you were able to notice some wonderful things. You're trying so hard, so please make some time to be kind to yourself as well. Just one step at a time.

dialogue.content: 夫も子どもみたいなので、誰かにねぎらって頂けたのが1番嬉しいかもしれません。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: My husband is like a child too, so having someone acknowledge my efforts might be the happiest part of this. Thank you so much!

dialogue.content: そうでしたかわたしもお話を聞かせて頂き、勇気をもらいました。またぜひ、お話聞かせてくださいね？
dialogue.English: Is that so? Listening to your story has given me courage as well. Please feel free to come and talk again anytime, okay?

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: それではそろそろお時間ですので、失礼させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Well, our time is just about up, so we'll have to end here for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。今日はこれで失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll sign off for today.

dialogue.content: はい、失礼致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, take care.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした。時間オーバーしてしまいすみませんでした)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. I’m sorry we went over.)

dialogue.content: (とんでもないです、お付き合いくださりありがとうございました。あとは評価の方、のちほど入れさせて頂きます)
dialogue.English: (Not at all, thank you for staying with me. I'll submit the evaluation later.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。失礼いたします)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. It was a learning experience for me. Goodbye.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそです！
dialogue.English: Likewise!
